info.text:
Oil just plunged 8.3% in one day. Gas hasn't.
US crude closed Wednesday, Nov 4, near $88.12 a barrel, oil's biggest daily drop since April. Brent went from near $118 on Oct. 30 to about $94.
Traders cited hopes for an end to the Iran war after Tuesday's midterms.
Gas averaged $4.12 Wednesday morning, 39% above pre-war levels; GasBuddy's Patrick De Haan says it could dip below $4 in the days ahead. Diesel futures fell nearly 7%. Oil is still more than 50% higher than at the start of the year.
Sources: NBC News, Rigzone (Nov 4, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
